coverage_gaps: No person-specific event involving a covered right-wing, Republican, conservative, or affiliated-organizational figure was located in Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Michigan, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, or Missouri that met the evidence and date-window rules.

The current official indexes reviewed exposed no qualifying new public-official misconduct action in the window. Ohio and Illinois had recent criminal releases involving private defendants or ordinary government employees without documented covered political affiliation; those were excluded.

Federal USAO results dated August 15 included ordinary criminal defendants, including a Madison firearm sentence, but no covered Midwest public official or documented right-wing-affiliated subject in the reviewed results.

Local police, sheriff, prosecutor, court, school-board, municipal, and ethics records are fragmented and not uniformly searchable from one public index. Several major regional-news domains were blocked by robots.txt, so negative coverage cannot be treated as exhaustive.
Routine arrests and criminal matters without an explicitly documented covered political or affiliated role were excluded. No unverified current lead was retained for quarantine in this run.
